scientific_integrity: Infinite assertions proved by conditional-root decomposition and Pólya urn moments. Exact finite enumeration is supplementary, not a substitute for proof. Classical total path length variance is acknowledged prior work.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent-parent recursive trees only, deterministic birth weights only; conditional component indicators are independent, but birth-ranked subtree sizes generally are not; historical priority beyond inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: Conditional young-forest factorization and orthogonal birth-ranked subtree sizes in random recursive trees
